title: Stop batch generation when identity evaluation is missing
starting_state: A proof image looks stylish and has text, but no structured face identity evaluation was run.
The package is about to continue generating remaining slides or claim proof pass.
done_when: No identity eval means no next slide.
The package records IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED_FOR_IDENTITY_EVAL with selected reference IDs and likeness notes.
Batch generation and final claims remain blocked until structured identity evidence exists.
forbidden_changes: Do not call manual visual taste notes an identity pass.
Do not continue batch generation from tiny, hidden, back-facing, or unverified faces.
Do not weaken identity reference requirements.
fail_to_pass: proof packages without structured identity reference IDs and likeness notes are blocked with IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED_FOR_IDENTITY_EVAL
pass_to_pass: object-only or back-facing slides can be part of a shot ladder, but cannot satisfy the identity pass required before batching face-visible finals
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should include a pretty proof with exact text and brandmark but only tiny faces, then assert can_continue_batch is false.
